title: 運動会の動物たち
subject_en: Cute animals taking part in a sports day, each ONE animal doing one event, full body, centred in its cell, with a simple prop, rounded kawaii shapes with dot eyes. Animals wear plain red or white headbands or caps only. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no numbers, no logos.
lead: かけっこ・玉入れ・綱引きなど運動会の競技をする動物を、かわいいタッチで描いた12点です。運動会のお知らせやプログラムに使えます。
items: かけっこをするうさぎ
a rabbit running a footrace with a red headband, ears flying back
a turtle slowly crossing a finish tape, smiling
a bear pulling a thick rope, leaning back with effort
a monkey throwing a red ball up toward a basket on a pole
リレーのバトンを渡すイヌ
a dog passing a relay baton to the next runner's paw
a cat jumping over a low hurdle
an elephant rolling a giant ball with its trunk
a penguin sliding forward on its belly in a race
two pandas running a three-legged race with their legs tied
a fox waving a big flag on a pole as cheering captain

メダルをもらうライオン
a lion standing proudly on a podium with a medal around its neck
